now.title: Iron Fist S1
now.text: In episode 11, Sensei Colleen Wing helps Danny fight the Hand, then breaks from Bakuto when she learns his faction is part of it.

proposed.text: In episode 11, Colleen Wing, who has been helping Danny fight Madame Gao's Hand while serving Bakuto's own faction of it, breaks from Bakuto after he has her tied up to be drained of blood.

changes.evidence: Colleen knowingly belongs to Bakuto's faction of the Hand (recruited and trained by him; in episode 10 she argues to Danny that her faction is good). She does not learn his faction is part of the Hand; she breaks with Bakuto in episode 11 after his students bind her to be drained of blood and she escapes to Danny.

now.title: Iron Fist S2
now.text: In episode 9, BB helps Danny reach Colleen, helps Joy steal Davos's bowl, and is killed standing up to his old gang.
cases: ST-073 The Chinatown Triad War (Iron Fist S2)

proposed.text: In episode 9, BB brings Colleen and Danny the bowl he took from Davos with Joy's help, then is stabbed to death when he urges his old gang to leave Davos.

changes.evidence: BB never helps Danny reach Colleen. In episode 8 Joy frees him and he digs the bowl out of Davos's hideout; in episode 9 he shows it to Colleen and Danny at the Bayard Community Center, then goes out to tell Crank and the gang to leave Davos, and Crank stabs him to death.
